# Bundled painting cache

The app ships ten generated paintings per style in `public/cache/`. Landscapes load a pre-rendered 4096 × 1024 PNG directly, fetching their compressed SVG source only when an export needs it. Other styles load the compressed original and display SVG; flowers retain the original generator’s raster artwork embedded in SVG. Opening a style automatically shows a random cached painting. Every click on Regenerate generates a fresh painting; returning to an already opened style reuses its decoded preview immediately. The last displayed painting is also restored after a reload. Generation, decompression, preview rendering, and pixel-based centering run in cancellable workers. Fresh paintings and their landscape previews persist in IndexedDB where available.

To rebuild the starter collection, install dependencies and run `npm run prepare-engines`. Serve the repository with a static HTTP server, open `scripts/cache/bake.html`, and choose **Prepare 40 paintings**. Keep that page open until **Save painting cache** becomes available. Extract the downloaded ZIP into `public/cache/`, run `node scripts/cache/measure-ink.mjs` to precompute centering, then run `npm run build`. Seeds are recorded in the manifest and full painting payloads; artwork credits and export backgrounds are preserved.

Landscapes use 3200 × 800 panoramic sources for the viewer, with a centered 800√2 × 800 crop for every export. `node scripts/cache/widen-landscapes.mjs` rebuilds the ten panoramic starter landscapes and their ink offsets. Landscape revision 2 rejects older narrow browser entries.

After rebuilding the landscapes or the starter collection, run `node scripts/cache/render-landscape-previews.mjs` to replace the ten high-resolution preview images and update the manifest. Keep the `.json.gz` SVG sources for vector exports; these are separate from the screen previews. Then run `npm run build`.

Each landscape also includes a 2048-pixel-wide `cropPreviewAsset` containing exactly the central export composition for phones. Use `--crop-only` to rebuild those ten crops without re-rendering the desktop panoramas. Shared seed URLs look up the original starter collection even when personal paintings have displaced it from the bounded browser cache.

Prepare lightweight first-load previews for Flowers, Fish and Maps with `node scripts/cache/prepare-direct-previews.mjs`. Flowers use the original transparent PNG pixels; Fish and Maps use the same SVG as the runtime preview. All thirty retain their separate compressed print source and measured ink offsets. Run this after replacing these cached paintings or changing their SVG formatting. No browser rendering is needed to build these previews.
